content.Title: 2024 Peripheral Artery Disease Guideline
Topics: Risk factors and management of peripheral artery disease (PAD)
Functional and quality of life assessments
Key Points: The use of vascular quality of life questionnaires facilitates the assessment of health-related quality of life in peripheral arterial disease.
Statins and major adverse limb events are important in managing patients with peripheral artery disease.
The PADQOL questionnaire is developed and validated for PAD-specific quality of life assessment.
Supervised exercise therapy improves walking distance in symptomatic patients with peripheral arterial disease.
The utility of electronic systems in vascular surgery, particularly in postoperative surveillance and data gathering.
